01: No prophet was ever sent... except that he warned his people about one man.
03: The Dajjal. The great liar at the end of time.
04: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: he is blind in one eye... and your Lord is not one-eyed.
05: But how do I protect myself from him?
06: The Prophet, peace be upon him, taught us: whoever memorises the first ten ayat of Surah Al-Kahf, the Cave, will be protected from the Dajjal.
07: All praise is due to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book, and has not made therein any deviance.
08: Then I'll learn one ayah every night. Ten nights... ten ayat.
